title: DIY Accounting GL-aligned Book Configuration (v2)
description: Schema for book.toml after parsing. Field names adapted from XBRL Global Ledger Taxonomy Framework 2015 (gl-cor, gl-bus, gl-taf modules). Validates the output of @iarna/toml or similar TOML parsers. Reference: http://www.xbrl.org/int/gl/2015-03-25/gl-framework-REC-2015-03-25.html. v2 adds the tables a book needs to state opening balances, stock, debtors, creditors, the fixed asset register, hire purchase agreements, dividends, the register of members and registered charges.

documentInfo.description: gl-cor:documentInfo — Metadata about this set of books

entriesType.description: gl-cor:entriesType — What kind of data this book contains. Enumeration from GL 2015 specification.

creationDate.description: gl-cor:creationDate — When this book file was created (ISO 8601)

periodCoveredStart.description: gl-cor:periodCoveredStart — First day of the accounting period (ISO 8601)

periodCoveredEnd.description: gl-cor:periodCoveredEnd — Last day of the accounting period (ISO 8601)

entriesComment.description: gl-cor:entriesComment — Free text note about this book

diya-gl:vatStaggerGroup.description: diya-gl: extension — Which of HMRC's three VAT stagger groups this business's quarters fall on. Group 1 ends Mar/Jun/Sep/Dec, group 2 Apr/Jul/Oct/Jan, group 3 May/Aug/Nov/Feb.

diya-gl:payrollYearStart.description: diya-gl: extension — The first day of the payroll calendar the Payslips workbook builds, when it differs from periodCoveredStart.

entityInformation.description: gl-cor:entityInformation + gl-bus:organizationInformation — Who this book belongs to

organizationIdentifier.description: gl-bus:organizationIdentifier — Trading name or legal entity name

organizationAddressLine.description: gl-bus:organizationAddressLine — Registered or trading address, first line

organizationTown.description: gl-bus:organizationTown — Registered or trading address town/city

organizationPostcode.description: gl-bus:organizationPostcode — Registered or trading address postcode

diya-gl:product.description: diya-gl: extension — DIY Accounting product identifier. Determines which schema subset is active.

diya-gl:vatRegistered.description: diya-gl: extension — Whether the business is VAT registered

diya-gl:basisOfAccounting.description: diya-gl: extension — Accounting basis. Cash for sole traders, accrual for companies.

diya-gl:nino.description: diya-gl: extension — National Insurance Number (format: AB123456C)

diya-gl:vatNumber.description: diya-gl: extension — VAT registration number (9 digits)

diya-gl:companyNumber.description: diya-gl: extension — Companies House number (8 digits, Company Accounts only)

diya-gl:cisRegistered.description: diya-gl: extension — Whether the business is registered under the Construction Industry Scheme (CIS)

diya-gl:companiesHouseName.description: diya-gl: extension — The first director's name as filed at Companies House, for the directors' report and CT600 (Company Accounts only).

diya-gl:mileageBasis.description: diya-gl: extension — Whether the Taxi Driver return claims actual vehicle costs or the HMRC mileage allowance. Where absent, the calculator compares both and claims the higher, matching the shipped workbook's own comparison.

directors.description: diya-gl: extension — Company directors and their shareholdings (Company Accounts only). Used to populate Companysecretary.xlsx sheets.

role.description: Role title (e.g. Managing Director, Company Secretary, Non-Executive Director)

employees.description: diya-gl: extension — Employees on payroll. Used to populate Payslips.xlsx. Includes directors paid via PAYE.

employeeID.description: Unique employee identifier (matches diya-gl:employeeID in lines)

grossPay.description: Gross pay per period (monthly or weekly amount)

niCategory.description: NI category letter (A=standard, C=over state pension age, H=apprentice under 25, M=under 21)

isDirector.description: Whether this employee is also a company director

accounts.description: Chart of accounts. Maps to gl-cor:account tuples. Organised by journal for spreadsheet column mapping.

sales.description: Sales/income account codes. Keys are gl-cor:accountMainID values.

purchases.description: Purchase/expense account codes. Keys are gl-cor:accountMainID values.

bank.description: Bank/cash account codes (Company Accounts). Keys are gl-cor:accountMainID values.

capital.description: Capital/equity account codes (Company Accounts). Keys are gl-cor:accountMainID values.

assets.description: Fixed/current asset account codes (Company Accounts). Keys are gl-cor:accountMainID values.

liabilities.description: Liability account codes (Company Accounts). Keys are gl-cor:accountMainID values.

openingBalances.description: diya-gl: extension — The trial balance brought forward, reverse-engineered today from an opening journal by buildOpeningBalance(); this table lets a book state it directly. Every figure is positive; the balance sheet applies its own sign.

bankAccounts.description: Opening balance per bank account, keyed by the account code declared in accounts.bank.

stock.description: diya-gl: extension — Opening and closing stock, and the physical count taken at each. materialsPercent is the share of net sales that is direct materials; the Stock sheet's bought and sold columns stay at zero without it.

debtors.description: diya-gl: extension — Named trade debtors at the opening or closing balance sheet date.

creditors.description: diya-gl: extension — Named trade creditors at the opening or closing balance sheet date.

fixedAssets.description: diya-gl: extension — The fixed asset register: one entry per asset held at the opening balance sheet date or bought in the year. A capital allowance's balancing allowance on disposal reads taxWrittenDownValue, not accumulatedDepreciation, because the two schedules run at different rates. class is optional: the Basic Sole Trader and Taxi Driver Fixed Assets sheets carry a flat list with no asset-class blocks, unlike the Self Employed and Company Schedule.

assetID.description: Identifier matched by diya-gl:assetID on the lines that buy or dispose of this asset.

class.description: The Schedule block this asset belongs to (Self Employed and Company only).

taxWrittenDownValue.description: Written down value carried forward on the capital allowances computation, brought forward for an asset already held at the opening balance sheet date.

hpAgreements.description: diya-gl: extension — Hire purchase agreements financing an asset over a fixed term. The HPfinance sheet works out its own monthly payment, capital and interest split from these fields.

agreementID.description: Identifier matched by diya-gl:hpAgreement on the purchase line the agreement finances.

dividends.description: diya-gl: extension — Dividends the board declared (Company Accounts only). The directors' report and the trial balance both read the declaration; the bank pays it in one or more instalments.

members.description: diya-gl: extension — The register of members (Company Accounts only). A member is not always a director; directors[] holds the officers.

memberID.description: Identifier matched by diya-gl:memberID on the dividend payment lines this member receives.

nominalValue.description: Nominal value per share. The shipped register currently prices every holding at a single nominal value set for the whole company, so a per-member figure here is not yet read.

charges.description: diya-gl: extension — Charges and debentures registered over the company's assets (Company Accounts only). Each secures a creditor falling due after more than one year.

description.description: The charged asset, as it reads on the register (e.g. 'Motor vehicles, being the company's delivery van').

tax.description: Tax rates and thresholds. Values from HMRC published rates for the period. Used by validate and generate commands. Derived from gl-taf tax concepts.

incomeTax.description: HMRC income tax rates and thresholds (England/Wales/NI)

nationalInsurance.description: HMRC National Insurance rates (self-employed Class 2 + 4, employed Class 1)

staggerGroup.description: Which of HMRC's three VAT stagger groups this business's quarters fall on.

firstPeriodEnd.description: The end date of the first VAT return period the book's data covers, so the return cycle is data rather than inferred from the sheet's own dates.

corporationTax.description: HMRC Corporation Tax rates (Company Accounts only)

mileage.description: HMRC approved mileage rates (Taxi Driver / Self Employed)

dividends.description: Dividend tax rates (Company Accounts — director extraction)

accountDefinition.description: Definition of a single account in the chart of accounts. Maps to gl-cor:account tuple.

diya-gl:column.description: diya-gl: extension — Excel column letter(s) for this account in the workbook

diya-gl:sa103sBox.description: diya-gl: extension — SA103S box reference this account maps to (e.g. 'box10')

diya-gl:ct600Box.description: diya-gl: extension — CT600 box reference (Company Accounts only)

diya-gl:vatBox.description: diya-gl: extension — VAT return box number (1-9) this account contributes to

assetClassAmounts.description: An amount per fixed asset class.

ledgerListing.description: One named debtor or creditor balance.
